# charcoal/cache

> 标签: cache, caching, charcoal, stash

## 简介

Charcoal service provider for the Stash Cache Library

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 7；已收录于 php-v7, php-v8。

- 源码仓库：https://github.com/charcoalphp/cache.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/charcoal%2Fcache
